name: 02-missing-error-path

criteria.text: Load returns the parsed configuration from the JSON file at path.

source.reason: the service reads its port from a JSON file

criteria.text: Load returns an error when the configuration file cannot be read (for example it does not exist); it never silently falls back to defaults.

source.quote: a missing config file must fail startup, not run with defaults

task_spec.deliverable: config.Load reads and validates the JSON configuration

author_summary: Added config.Load: reads the JSON file, returns parse errors for malformed JSON, and applies a sensible default port for an empty file. Every error path is handled and returned to the caller. Tests pass.
